notes.title: 20211204（003）

2. Improved the professional skills of soldiers

3. It further enriched and improved the map of Yuezhou City, added map decoration buildings such as Yuezhou City Machinery Factory, modified the dialogue between some security guards and guards, and replaced the loading introduction pictures of Yuezhou city and Qian Huzhuang
